visualCharacteristics.purpose: Section nav for the sibling pages of a condition (Symptoms & causes, Diagnosis & treatment, Doctors & departments, Care at Mayo Clinic)
visualCharacteristics.description: Bold condition title, then single-column rows separated by thin rules; the current page is bold plain text with an arrow, siblings are blue links. Sticky left rail beside the article in a split section on desktop; on mobile it sits above the article and repeats after it.

contentPattern.structure: Title row (plain text); current page row (plain text); one row per sibling page link
contentPattern.description: The source tab row is a list of links to sibling pages, not tab panels, so it is Cards with one cell per row. The first row without a link is the title; any later row without a link (or a link to the current URL) is the current page and gets aria-current="page".
contentPattern.blockContent: Atrial fibrillation; Symptoms and causes (current); Diagnosis and treatment; Doctors and departments; Care at Mayo Clinic
table: Current page label (plain text, no link)

usage: Left-rail nav between the pages of one condition. Put it first in a section whose Section Metadata style is "split"; the article default content and blocks that follow fill the right column.
reuseGuidance: Use for any set of sibling pages about one topic. Author one copy only: the code repeats it after the article on mobile. Keep the current page as plain text.
